hillfolk.name: Hillfolk
hillfolk.text: Raised on terraced slopes; sure of foot, slow to trust.

reedfolk.name: Reedfolk
reedfolk.text: Raised among marsh channels; quiet movers, quick swimmers.

quick_step.name: Quick Step
quick_step.text: Moves first when a scuffle starts.

iron_gut.name: Iron Gut
iron_gut.text: Shrugs off spoiled food and weak poisons.
